title: The Last Yearbook
author: J. M. Crane
blurb: Paloma Almeida, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before prom.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
